name: Global Hydrocarbon Supply Disruption
title: Iran – Saudi Arabia – US · Hydrocarbon Supply Disruption

definition.question: How severely is global oil and gas physical supply disrupted or constrained?
definition.low_end: Global oil and gas flows at normal volumes with ample spare capacity, open chokepoints and inventories at seasonal norms.
definition.high_end: Widespread physical shortfall with major producers offline and key chokepoints effectively closed, forcing rationing and inability to meet global demand.

readings.rationale: Hormuz flows are operationally constrained not fully closed: 20m b/d normal (EIA) vs 8m b/d on Sunday and 15m b/d regional average, vessel transits down ~60% (14 vs 37, 6 vessels lowest in 5 weeks) to multi-week lows, traffic still fraction of pre-war despite 800+ vessels facilitated since May. Inventories down 400m barrels in 2026, EIA expects constraints through end-2026 and below pre-conflict…

More extreme than 2026-10-01 at 72 which reflected Hormuz-only operational constraint (20m b/d normal vs 8m b/d Sunday/15m avg, -60% transits, 800+ vessels facilitated). New evidence shows severely impaired but not fully closed system now with second chokepoint: Hormuz -70% traffic plus Houthi complete blockade on Saudi 20 Jul and seizure of Mokha/Hanish Islands 10 Sep controlling Bab el-Mandeb…
